Enter the awarding flow for the closed RFQ.
Allocate the available prepared line item to the vendor named in the case.
Verify the available line item and vendor are fully allocated before proposal creation.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify that proposal creation opened the proposal page.
